name: Hotel Sacher Wien
positioning: Privately owned hotel in central Vienna (officially Hotel Sacher Vienna), founded by Eduard Sacher and steps from the Vienna State Opera, with Cafe Sacher Wien serving the Original Sacher-Torte
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to the Vienna State Opera, the Albertina and St. Stephen's Cathedral
Food lovers interested in classic Viennese cuisine and coffee house culture

facts.text: The hotel was founded by Eduard Sacher, son of the creator of the Original Sacher-Torte; under Anna Sacher it became a meeting place for nobility, artists and businessmen.
Franz Sacher created the Original Sacher-Torte in 1832, and it is still handcrafted in 34 steps.
Since 1934 the hotel has been managed by the Gürtler family and is privately owned.
The rooms and suites were designed by co-owner Alexandra Winkler with French designer Pierre-Yves Rochon.
The hotel is steps from the Vienna State Opera, the Albertina Museum and St. Stephen's Cathedral, and the main sights are reachable on foot.
The hotel is within steps of Karlsplatz/Oper, a hub for U-Bahn lines U1 and U4.
Restaurant Rote Bar serves authentic Austrian cuisine, with classic Viennese dishes made from seasonal and regional ingredients.
Restaurant Grüne Bar offers international haute cuisine with modern accents and regional influence, with both set menus and a la carte.
At lunch and dinner, Cafe Sacher Wien serves classic Viennese dishes such as Wiener Schnitzel, veal goulash and Original Sacher Sausages, plus vegetarian and vegan options.
The Sacher Boutique Spa has a hammam, a sauna and a fitness room.
The concierge service is available around the clock.

highlights.text: Cafe Sacher Wien serves the Original Sacher-Torte alongside Viennese coffees and apple and curd cheese strudel.
Some rooms look onto Kärntner Strasse, the Vienna State Opera or the Albertina Museum; others overlook the quiet Maysedergasse or the courtyard.
On request the hotel organizes horse-drawn carriage rides through the Old Town, Danube river cruises and customized city tours.
The Original Sacher-Torte is sold in various sizes at the in-house Sacher Shop, and online orders ship worldwide.

considerations.text: The hotel has no swimming pool.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning and historic significance.
There is no formal dress code, but smart casual to elegant attire is recommended in Rote Bar and Grüne Bar.
